| 3 | `conventions.error_sentinels[]` (`builder.go:229-234`) | `ErrNotFound`, `ErrConflict`, `ErrBadReference`, `ErrInvalidInput`, `ErrForbidden` | **1 of 5.** Only `ErrNotFound` is generated. |
| 4 | `methods[].errors[]` (`builder.go:1218, 1227, 1254`) | `ErrConflict`, `ErrBadReference`, `ErrInvalidInput` | **No.** On every `Create` / `Update` / `Upsert` of **every table**. |
| 5 | `methods[].errors[]` (`builder.go:1391`) | `ErrRefreshConcurrentlyInTx` | **Real, but under-qualified** — see below. |

`grep -rn "ErrForbidden\|ErrUnauthenticated"` over `database/ sql/ comparator/ tenancy/ manifest/
hook/ cache/`, over `cmd/sqlgen/gen/templates/`, and over every generated `*.go` in the example
trees returns **nothing**. The strings exist only in `cmd/sqlgen/manifest/builder.go`, in the
manifest goldens it produces, and in PRD §30.4.1's worked example.

What a tenanted example's `errors_gen.go` actually declares — exactly the seven of PRD §22.1,
which `error.go.tmpl` re-exports verbatim:

```
ErrNotFound  ErrEmptyFilter  ErrAmbiguousFilter  ErrInvalidCursor
ErrDeadlock  ErrConnectionFailed  ErrConstraintViolation
```

So the conventions block **names four sentinels that do not exist and omits six that do.**

**Root cause — a fabrication the PRD already corrected once, in a different section.** §26.5.5's
error-mapping table is the authority: `database.ErrNotFound` → `NOT_FOUND`,
`*database.ConstraintError{ConstraintUnique}` → `CONFLICT`, `{ConstraintForeignKey}` →
`BAD_REFERENCE`, `{ConstraintCheck|ConstraintNotNull}` → `INVALID_INPUT`, `tenancy.ErrMissing` →
`UNAUTHENTICATED`, `tenancy.ErrMismatch` → `FORBIDDEN`. Someone read that **code** column and
PascalCased it into a `name` column. §26.5.5 itself carries the matching correction for the
constraint half — *"No `ErrUniqueViolation` / `ErrForeignKeyViolation` / `ErrCheckViolation` /
`ErrNotNullViolation` aliases exist on the runtime — earlier drafts of this section listed them as
if they did"* — but §30.4.1's example and the manifest builder were never brought along. The four
constraint codes have no standalone sentinel at all: they are one structured `*database.ConstraintError`
discriminated by `Type` (§22.2).

**Why it matters more than a stale string.** The manifest's stated purpose (§30.1) is to answer
"codegen-time / build-time / **agent-time**" questions, and `conventions.error_sentinels` is
consumed through MCP §31 — `sqlgen_get_conventions` (`cmd/sqlgen/mcp/tools_meta.go:29`) and the
`sqlgen://conventions` resource return the block verbatim. An agent told to
`errors.Is(err, models.ErrForbidden)` writes code that does not compile; an agent told a tenanted
read fails with `ErrUnauthenticated` writes a handler that never fires, because the real return is
`tenancy.ErrMissing`. This is the advertise-something-that-does-not-exist twin of the
accept-and-ignore class Phase 25 exists to eliminate — same failure mode, opposite direction.

**Scope.** Affects **every tenanted table** (sites 1–2) and **every table with a write path**
(site 4) in every generate run, not just views — which is why it was pulled out of 25.6/25.7
rather than fixed inside a view sub-item.

#### Widened findings (verification pass, 2026-09-03)

- **Site 4 — `methods[].errors[]` is the most directly damaging.** It is what an agent reads to
  write a handler for one method. It is also **incomplete** for tenanted entities: `workspace_setting`
  is `mode: "verify-match"`, so its `Create` genuinely can return `tenancy.ErrMismatch` (and
  `tenancy.ErrMissing` under `required: true`) — and it currently lists
  `["ErrConflict","ErrBadReference","ErrInvalidInput"]`, none of which exist and none of which is
  the tenancy error. Constraint: `method.errors` is `array of string` **and a `required` member**
  in `schema/v1.json`, so it cannot become objects without breaking the `0.1.0` freeze; whatever
  goes there must be plain Go identifier strings.
- **Site 5 — `ErrRefreshConcurrentlyInTx` is real but does not resolve in the generated package.**
  §22.1's list has seven entries and this is not one; `error.go.tmpl` does not re-export it, so it
  exists only as `database.ErrRefreshConcurrentlyInTx` (which is how §16.5's own prose spells it).
  §30.4.2 blesses the bare spelling, so the compile-pin this entry originally proposed would have
  failed on a name that is not a fabrication.
- **`conventions.error_sentinels[].package` is hardcoded `"models"`** (`builder.go:230-234`) while
  the real value is `cfg.Output.Package`, already used 150 lines up at `builder.go:78`. Every
  example happens to use `models`, so this is latent rather than visible.
- **`docs/design/MANIFEST.md:1064-1080`** shows an `examples.write` block containing literal
  `errors.Is(err, models.ErrConflict)` — non-compiling Go. Harmless today because `builder.go:331`
  emits `&Examples{}` empty, but it is the template a future examples pass would copy.
- **The original "derive it" premise was wrong.** `error.go.tmpl` is a static literal with
  per-sentinel doc prose — there is nothing to derive *from* without inventing a source, and
  restructuring it to range over a data slice would churn every `errors_gen.go` to buy a guarantee
  a test gives for free. `gen` cannot host that test either: `manifest` imports `gen`, so the
  reverse is a cycle.
- **The schema freeze holds, but not for the reason originally stated.** `error_sentinels[].items`
  *does* declare `required: ["name","graphql_code","package"]`. A sentinel with no GraphQL mapping
  must therefore still carry the key; `""` validates, so `0.1.0` survives. `features.tenancy` does
  have no required members, as stated.

#### Decisions (settled with the user, 2026-09-03)

1. **`features.tenancy.*_error` carry the qualified Go sentinel** — `tenancy.ErrMissing` /
   `tenancy.ErrMismatch`. These fields have no `package` sibling, so the qualified spelling is the
   only unambiguous one, and the symbols live in the runtime `tenancy` package rather than the
   generated one.
2. **`conventions.error_sentinels[]` lists the seven generated sentinels plus the two tenancy
   ones.** Names stay **bare** here — this shape *has* a `package` column, which carries
   `cfg.Output.Package` for the seven and `"tenancy"` for the two. `graphql_code` carries the
   §26.5.5 value where a 1:1 mapping exists and `""` otherwise (`ErrEmptyFilter`,
   `ErrAmbiguousFilter`, `ErrInvalidCursor`, `ErrDeadlock`, `ErrConnectionFailed`, and
   `ErrConstraintViolation`, which maps 1:N by `ConstraintError.Type`).
3. **The two tenancy rows are gated on tenancy being configured.** Same "don't advertise what the
   package can't return" principle as §30.4.2's `mismatch_error`-omitted rule. The `graphql` tree
   emits nine rows, the `postgres` / `mysql` / `sqlite` trees seven.
4. **`methods[].errors[]` carries real names, plus tenancy errors when the entity is tenanted.**
   `Create` / `Upsert` → `ErrConstraintViolation`; `Update` → `ErrNotFound`,
   `ErrConstraintViolation`; a tenanted entity additionally lists `tenancy.ErrMissing` and, in
   `verify-match` mode, `tenancy.ErrMismatch`. The per-constraint-type hint is not lost — it moves
   to decision 5.
5. **The constraint → GraphQL-code mapping moves to a structured sibling block**
   `conventions.constraint_error_codes`, keyed by `ConstraintError.Type`:
   `{"unique":"CONFLICT","foreign_key":"BAD_REFERENCE","check":"INVALID_INPUT","not_null":"INVALID_INPUT"}`.
   Machine-readable, which is what §30.1's agent-time purpose asks for. `conventions` is
   `additionalProperties: true` and not itself `required`, so **no schema bump** — but it needs a
   §30.4.1 amendment alongside the one already required.
6. **`ErrRefreshConcurrentlyInTx` is qualified** to `database.ErrRefreshConcurrentlyInTx` in
   `methods[].errors[]`, matching decision 4's qualification rule and §16.5's own prose. Needs a
   one-sentence §30.4.2 amendment. It is **not** added to `error_sentinels[]`.
7. **`package` is derived** from `cfg.Output.Package` rather than hardcoded `"models"`;
   `buildConventions()` gains a `*config.RootConfig` parameter (which it needs for decision 3
   anyway).
8. **Drift guard instead of derivation.** A test in package `manifest` AST-parses the checked-in
   `cmd/sqlgen/testdata/examples/postgres/models/errors_gen.go` `var` block and asserts set
   equality against the `package == cfg.Output.Package` subset of `conventions.error_sentinels`.
   This is the pin the entry originally asked for, with no new indirection and no golden churn: if
   the errors template changes, `make update-golden-e2e` regenerates that file and the test catches
   the divergence.

**Sequencing.** **FIX-180 lands before 25.7.** The view-tenancy sub-item then inherits the
corrected values, and its explicit task *"keep `missing_resolver_error: "ErrUnauthenticated"` on the
view block for consistency with the table row"* is dropped rather than carried — that task exists
only because this entry was open. 25.7's separate `mismatch_error` `,omitempty` task is unaffected
and still stands.

**Blast radius.** PRD §30.4.1's worked example must be amended alongside (it currently shows the
fabricated list, so it is not merely illustrative — it blesses the bug), plus the §30.4.2 sentence
for decision 6 and `docs/design/MANIFEST.md` (the `error_sentinels` table at :788, the `features.tenancy`
block at :1139-1140, the `methods[].errors` examples at :1002-1017 / :1148-1149, and the
non-compiling `examples.write` block at :1064-1080). Golden churn is **~190 files**, not the 16
first estimated — the per-entity **markdown** renders `- Errors: …` for every table
(`product.md:120`), so all four example trees churn twice over (`expected/` + `models/`), plus
`cmd/sqlgen/manifest/testdata/golden/*`, `cmd/sqlgen/mcp/testdata/manifest_gen.json`, and
`cmd/sqlgen/cli/testdata/manifest/valid_single.json`. Mechanical via `make update-golden` +
`make update-golden-e2e`, plus three hand-edited Go fixtures (`emit_json_test.go:42-44,190`,
`cmd_manifest_diff_test.go:45`, `mcp/tools_entity_test.go:183`). **No JSON-schema change** —
`features.tenancy` declares no `required` members, `conventions` accepts the new
`constraint_error_codes` key under `additionalProperties: true`, and every emitted sentinel still
carries the required `graphql_code` (possibly `""`), so the `0.1.0` freeze holds.

**Reproduction.** The claim that the names do not exist is from exhaustive grep over the runtime
packages, the templates, and the generated example trees, cross-checked against `tenancy/tenancy.go:39,46`,
`database/errors.go`, `cmd/sqlgen/gen/templates/error.go.tmpl`, and PRD §22.1. Decision 8's drift
guard is the standing pin.

**Resolution notes (2026-09-03).** All eight decisions implemented as recorded, ahead of 25.7.

*Builder* (`cmd/sqlgen/manifest/builder.go`) — `buildConventions` now takes `*config.RootConfig`:
`error_sentinels[]` lists the seven PRD §22.1 sentinels in declaration order with
`package = cfg.Output.Package` (no longer the hardcoded `"models"`), plus bare `ErrMissing` /
`ErrMismatch` with `package: "tenancy"` behind a new shared `tenancyEnabled(cfg)` predicate that
`generation_config.tenancy` now also uses, so the two can never disagree. `graphql_code` is
`NOT_FOUND` for `ErrNotFound` and `""` for the other six. The new `constraint_error_codes` map
carries the §26.5.5 per-`ConstraintType` codes. `buildTenancyFeature` emits `tenancy.ErrMissing` /
`tenancy.ErrMismatch`. `buildMethods` gained a `tCfg` parameter feeding a `tenancyReach` value on
`methodCtx`; mutations list `ErrConstraintViolation` (+ `ErrNotFound` where applicable) plus the
tenancy sentinels when tenanted. `database.ErrRefreshConcurrentlyInTx` is now qualified.

*Two reachability facts measured against the templates, tightening decision 4 as written:*
`tenancy.ErrMissing` is gated on `ResolveTableTenancyRequired` (default `true`) — under
`required: false` with a zero resolver, `apply=false` and no error is produced. And `ErrMismatch`
is **not** verify-match-only: `create` / `update` / `upsert` reach it in the auto-filter shape too
(a caller-set tenant on the input that differs from the resolved one), while only the by-PK deletes
are guarded on `and .Tenancy.InPrimaryKey .CompositePK`. Verified in the regenerated goldens:
`WorkspaceSetting` (composite-PK tenant) lists `tenancy.ErrMismatch` on `Delete`; `WorkspaceNote`
(auto-filter) does not, but does on `Create` / `Update` / `Upsert`.

*Query methods keep `errors: []`.* That list was already a curated set of method-specific errors,
not an exhaustive one — every read can return `ErrDeadlock` / `ErrConnectionFailed`, and paginated
reads `ErrInvalidCursor`, none of which were ever listed. Adding only the tenancy sentinels there
would have made the curation inconsistent rather than more complete. Out of scope for this entry.

*Types* — `ConstraintErrorCodes map[string]string` added to `Conventions` in **both**
`cmd/sqlgen/manifest/types.go` and the runtime `manifest/types.go` (still hand-duplicated; the
drift guard 25.7 adds covers `TenancyFeature`, not this). `ErrorSentinel` gained a doc comment

*Schema* — `schema/v1.json` documents `constraint_error_codes` and describes `error_sentinels`.
`SchemaVersion` **stays `0.1.0`** by user direction, though §30.5's "adding optional fields → minor
bump" rule would otherwise have applied; the field ships under `conventions`'
`additionalProperties: true`.

*Markdown* — `_conventions.md.tmpl` renders an empty `graphql_code` as `—` rather than empty
backticks and gained a "Constraint error codes" section (via the existing `sortedPairs` func —
no map iteration in templates).

*Drift guard* — new `cmd/sqlgen/manifest/sentinel_drift_test.go`:
`TestErrorSentinelsMatchGeneratedPackage` AST-parses the `var` block of the checked-in
`testdata/examples/postgres/models/errors_gen.go` and asserts set equality (both directions)
against the `package == output.package` subset of `conventions.error_sentinels`;
`TestErrorSentinelsCarryQualifiedPackages` pins the bare-vs-qualified rule across the three sites.
`error.go.tmpl` was deliberately **not** restructured into a data-driven range — it is prose with
per-sentinel doc comments, and the test buys the same guarantee with no golden churn.

*Docs* — PRD §30.4.1's worked example corrected, with a new paragraph stating the
bare-vs-qualified rule and the 1:N `ErrConstraintViolation` case, plus a `> Correction (FIX-180)`
note; §30.4.2's `RefreshConcurrently` sentence now qualifies the sentinel and its `methods[].errors`

every `methods[].errors` sample, the `features.tenancy` block, and the `examples.write` snippet —
which showed literal non-compiling `errors.Is(err, models.ErrConflict)` and is the template a
future examples pass would have copied — now use `errors.As` + `ConstraintError.Type`.

*Trackers* — `docs/tracker/phase-25.md`'s 25.7 task "keep `ErrUnauthenticated` on the view block"
is struck as moot: the view block inherits the corrected values from `buildTenancyFeature` with no
view-specific work. 25.7's separate `mismatch_error` `,omitempty` task is untouched.

*Verification* — `make check` clean across all 33 modules under `-race`; `make check-examples`
clean across all 13 example modules (Docker); `make update-golden-e2e` + the manifest package's
`-update` regenerated 190 goldens. Two hand-authored JSON fixtures
(`cmd/sqlgen/cli/testdata/manifest/valid_single.json`, `cmd/sqlgen/mcp/testdata/manifest_gen.json`)
and four Go test fixtures were updated by hand. `grep` for the four fabricated names now returns

**Auto-review (2026-09-03) — 7 of 8 decisions fully implemented, one test gap, two real defects found and
fixed.** The reviewer independently re-derived the ErrMissing/ErrMismatch reachability against the templates

case), and confirmed the drift guard's fixture is genuinely regenerated in place by `-update-e2e`
(`e2e_test.go:160-168`) rather than co-updated. Three findings were fixed inline:

1. **`docs/design/MANIFEST.md`'s rewritten `examples.write` snippet was still non-compiling Go** — the replacement

2. **PRD §30.4.1's new qualification paragraph overstated the rule** — it read as though `methods[].errors[]`

3. **`docs/tracker/phase-18.md:293`** still specified the conventions template as "5 entries: `ErrNotFound`,

**Test gap closed.** `methods[].errors[]` — the site this entry calls the most directly damaging — was pinned

Verified by perturbation: restoring the original `["ErrConflict", "ErrBadReference", "ErrInvalidInput"]` on

**Two observations surfaced, not fixed — both pre-existing and outside this entry:**

- **`Increment` is absent from `methods[]` entirely.** `buildMutationMethods` covers Create / Update / Delete /

- **`mode: "verify-match"` on a single-column PK that is itself the tenant column.** `buildTenancyFeature`

  which likely does not generate compiling code at all — so the shape is probably unreachable rather than
